question: How many orders are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders

question: How many orders are in each status?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY orders DESC

question: What is the status of order 1042?
sql: SELECT order_id, status, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_id = 1042

question: When was order 1042 delivered and by which carrier?
sql: SELECT o.order_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_at, s.delivered_at FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_id = 1042

question: How many orders are still in transit?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS in_transit FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped'

question: What is the total revenue from delivered orders?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

question: What is the average order value excluding cancelled orders?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled'

question: Which 5 products sold the most units?
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question: Revenue by product category
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Number of orders per month in 2026
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Revenue in September 2026
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) = '2026-09' AND status <> 'cancelled'

question: Orders placed in the last 30 days
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS recent_orders FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date('2026-09-30', '-30 days')

question: How many orders were placed in Q4 2025?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31'

question: Average delivery time in days for each carrier
sql: SELECT carrier, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_at) - julianday(shipped_at)), 1) AS avg_days FROM shipments WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY avg_days

question: How many customers are in each segment?
sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers GROUP BY segment

question: How many customers live in Austin?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE city = 'Austin'

question: How many orders were shipped to Austin?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE shipping_city = 'Austin'

question: Which customers have never placed an order?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.full_name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

question: Which products have never been ordered?
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_item_id IS NULL

question: Top 10 customers by total spend
sql: SELECT c.full_name, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 10

question: Customers with more than 5 orders
sql: SELECT c.full_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 5 ORDER BY orders DESC

question: What percentage of orders were cancelled?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancel_pct FROM orders

question: How many returns were requested per product category?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_id) AS returns FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY returns DESC

question: How many returns were requested for each reason?
sql: SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS returns FROM returns GROUP BY reason ORDER BY returns DESC

question: Total refunded through returns
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS total_refunds FROM returns

question: How many payments failed?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_payments FROM payments WHERE status = 'failed'

question: Average rating for each product with at least 5 reviews
sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS reviews FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

question: Which products are tagged eco-friendly?
sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN product_tags pt ON pt.product_id = p.product_id JOIN tags t ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id WHERE t.name = 'eco-friendly' ORDER BY p.name

question: Tags for product 10
sql: SELECT t.name FROM tags t JOIN product_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE pt.product_id = 10 ORDER BY t.name

question: Which carrier handles the most shipments?
sql: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS shipments FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY shipments DESC LIMIT 1

question: Average order value by payment method
sql: SELECT payment_method, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

question: Total spend of business customers
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS business_spend FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'business' AND o.status <> 'cancelled'

question: Which shipping city receives the most orders?
sql: SELECT shipping_city, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY shipping_city ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1
